The excluded share can change the sample when the omitted rows are closures or missing prices. #> - The coefficient is the association in the rows that remain under this specification. It is not a causal price elasticity. It is not a recommendation to change a posted price. A positive coefficient is not evidence that demand rises with price. #> - Rounds played can be censored at capacity. This fit does not correct for that. #> - An average of prices paid is not a posted rack rate.
